reason: No on the text's necessity/urgency, not on the definitional fix in principle. The Clerk's check shows the 99% unreadable figure is the compliance checker not recognising Act 26 delivery records, not the self-reference this bill fixes; that is an Executive checker repair, not a law change. The self-reference is real, but no blocked work, false green or red-main event is demonstrated, and unreadable is the safe fail-closed interim. O5/B5 remain unresolved: an informal or written carrier reading may suffice, and the bill's own withdrawal condition is not met. Enacting now adds a statute, implementation and audit burden before an end-to-end green checker exists. The candidate/carrier safeguards are good; after the checker is fixed and the carrier issue is shown to persist, a clean bill should return.
